items.title: Sheila Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Middleburgh, New York, May 11, 2002
items.q: I think Warne Marsh was up there that night playing.

ctx.x: Oh it was horrible. They would stop us in the car, if they’d see you mixing they used to call it. Mix. They didn’t want you to mix as they say, you know, the blacks with the whites. And they’d see you in a car, the cops would stop. “Where were you born? Where are you going? Where are you coming from?” I mean third degree like you wouldn’t believe. I’ve been taken down to the police station in Detroit when I was going with Frank Foster. We were going out to Belle Isle, Frank Foster and myself were in the back and…

out.” I swear to God, Monk, I swear to God. That is what he said to me. And I thought oh my God and then something said don’t say nothing. Shut up. He’s waiting to get your reaction and if you flip out they’ll put you for assaulting an officer or whatever, you know? So I said, “Oh, gosh,” I said, “boy that’s strong,” or something like that I said. Well I said, “I’m not going to be staying in Detroit anyway.” I said, “I’m going to New York.” Well I was chasing Bird you know. So he said, “Oh we’re so cosmopolitan.”…
